No live class

A free list can’t show what working with you feels like

Your audacity list is a great first step, but it’s a page, not you. Nobody gets an hour in the room with you before they’re asked to apply for 1:1.

No path

Seven links, one page, no order

Your free practice, two classes, sessions and coaching sit side by side on bio.site. Each visitor has to work out the next step alone, and most will close the tab.

Reach

Every launch depends on which reel lands

Your last 7 reels ranged from 1.5k to 12.8k views. Even the best one reached about 1 in 7 of your 89.7k followers.

Your next 1:1 clients are probably already following you. Right now there’s no moment that shows you who they are.

My recommendation

A free live class that sells the products you already have, and finds your 1:1 clients

Because you already have classes to sell, the masterclass itself should be free. Your existing products become the upsells, so the class earns from day one and pays for its own ads.

Fixes the missing live class

An hour with you, free, is the easiest yes anyone who follows you can give. They feel how you teach, and every sign-up is an email you keep.

Gives every product its place

Instead of seven links side by side, each offer shows up at the moment it makes sense: The Inner Tarot Class right after sign-up, Enter Flow State after the class, 1:1 for the ones who want more.

Makes ads pay for themselves

Class and Flow State sales cover the ad spend, so reach no longer depends on which reel lands, and every new 1:1 client comes in on top.

The 95%*

Curious, not ready for 1:1 yet

They join the free class, many add The Inner Tarot Class, and some go deeper with Enter Flow State. You get paid to start the relationship instead of losing them to the scroll.

The qualified 5%

Ready for 1:1 support

They show up live, stay to the end and apply on the replay page. The application filters them before your calendar, and the pre-call emails warm them up for coaching.

*The 95% / 5% split is an industry estimate, not your data.

Does this sound like you?

You already know more than you let yourself trust

  • You get a clear feeling about something, then talk yourself out of it.
  • You ask everyone else what they think before you ask yourself.
  • Your creativity comes in bursts, then goes quiet for weeks.
  • You know you want more from your life, but can’t name the next step.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll explore together in one hour

How to tell your intuition from fear

The difference between a quiet inner knowing and an anxious thought, and how to notice which one is talking.

A five-minute daily check-in with yourself

A simple practice to ask yourself first, before you ask everyone else.

Tarot as a mirror, not a forecast

How to use the cards to reflect on what you already feel, even if you’ve never held a deck.

Working with your creative energy

How to notice your natural rhythms through the month and plan your creative work around them.

From inner knowing to one brave step

Turn what you hear into one audacious action you can take this week.

Meet Kate

Questions

Before you save your seat

Do I need to know tarot?

Not at all. We use the cards as a reflection tool, and everything is explained from scratch.

Is this a reading?

No. It’s a class on building your own intuitive practice. It doesn’t predict anything; it helps you listen to yourself.

What if I can’t make it live?

Sign up anyway. Everyone who registers gets the replay.

Is it really free?

Yes. Come, try the practices, and decide afterwards if you want to go deeper.
